subject: Renewal: Priority Response & capacity add-on — Helio Labs
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@heliolabs.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Labs Legal <legal@heliolabs.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal & priority response upgrade

Hi Elliot / Marissa,

We're coming up on our 12-month renewal next month and wanted to share where Helio is headed. Usage has grown ~3x this year and our core inference traffic now spikes during ET business hours. We'd like to:  
- Lock a 12‑month renewal with a 25% capacity increase (predictable committed throughput)
- Add the "Priority Response" support tier (faster incident response + monthly SLO reviews)
- Capture a latency target for p95 at 300ms for the majority of our generation calls

I've attached a short spreadsheet with the current traffic and projected growth. Can we get a draft SLA that shows the new latency targets and what dedicated capacity path looks like? Also please flag any procurement items your legal team will want ahead of time.

Thanks,
Sophie
Senior Platform Ops, Helio Labs
attachments: Helio_Capacity_Request_0427.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@heliolabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal & priority response upgrade

Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. Quick notes upfront:  
1) We can propose a 12‑month committed capacity plan + a burst allowance for seasonal spikes.
2) Priority Response is scoped as a support tier + operational onramp: 15‑minute initial incident ack for Sev1, 1‑hour mitigation SLA for platform issues, and a monthly review cadence.
3) Latency p95 @ 300ms is aggressive but likely achievable with a dedicated pool + optimized batching and cache rules. We'll show the economics in a draft.

Marissa — can you draft the updated SLA showing the response times, SLOs, and the dedicated capacity pricing? Ben, can you outline the onboarding timeline to get Helio onto a dedicated pool (including KV cache warming and rollout plan)?

Elliot
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@heliolabs.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Labs Legal <legal@heliolabs.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal & priority response upgrade

Hi Sophie — attaching a draft SLA and a short pricing appendix. Key items called out in the doc:  
- Service levels: p50/p90/p95 latency buckets, p95 target shown at 300ms for the committed pool with allowed exceptions for oversized inputs.
- Support: Priority Response adds a named oncall rotations, 24/7 escalation bridge for Sev1, and two annual SLO readouts with runbook review.
- Credits & remedies: Service credits tiers for missed monthly SLOs; a 30% cap on cumulative credits per term.
- Term & pricing: 12‑month term with a 10% volume discount if Helio signs a 12‑month prepay for committed credits.

I've added optional language for a "capacity burst" allowance that Helio can consume at list rate beyond committed capacity. If legal has redlines, please share and we'll iterate.

attachments: Redwood_Premium_SLA_draft_v3.pdf (pdf)

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Enterprise Contracts — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@heliolabs.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Operational onramp for dedicated pool and latency tuning

Hi all — following up on Marissa's SLA draft with a proposed ops timeline and checklist to hit the p95 target. High level:  
Week 0 (agreement signed): create dedicated GPU pool, provision network peering if required, assign customer key vault integration.
Week 1: baseline telemetry collection (sample traffic on staging dedicated), pre-warm KV cache with recent prefixes, enable continuous batching profile tuned for Helio's median sequence length.
Week 2: controlled canary on 10% of traffic, measure p95 and tail latencies, tweak kernel configuration.
Week 3: full cutover, enable autoscale policies and burst cap.

I'll coordinate a 1‑hour onboarding kickoff meeting and include SRE runbook artifacts. Camila — adding you for post‑cutover monitoring dashboards and cost control knobs (caching, batching thresholds, quantization suggestions).

attachments: (none)

Also requesting a one‑page appendix that spells out: committed throughput (tokens/sec), expected p95 baseline with current traffic, and a clarified burst billing formula.

I've attached the redlines doc. Can the team update the SLA and send a DocuSign link by Monday? We'd like to lock pricing by early next week so procurement can process the PO.

Sophie — acknowledged. We're updating the SLA with your redlines and will produce a 1‑page technical appendix showing tokens/sec and the burst billing formula. Expect a DocuSign link by EOD Monday. Next steps:  
1) I'll incorporate legal comments and lock the pricing appendix (Marissa).
2) Ben & Camila will schedule the onboarding kickoff for the week after signature.
3) Elliot will send the PO instructions and final deal id for your procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping Helio online through the next growth phase.

—Marissa
